lines.text: [warm] No CMS, no developer, no problem. Ryze can host your whole blog — here's the Blog Studio.
This is your blog — a real, live site. Ryze hosts it for you on a free subdomain, or on your own domain — that's it in the corner. Every article from your content plan publishes straight onto it.
And you design it right here, no code. Themes, colors, fonts, corners, layout — watch. [curious] One click — and the whole blog goes dark.

Better yet — don't design it at all. Hit match my website style — and watch. [curious] The agent opens, visits your live site, reads your colors, your fonts, your header and footer — and rebuilds the blog to match, right in front of you. Your readers never notice they changed domains.

Now Google. [pause] Click your blog's address — this is where a custom domain connects. And you'll want one: Search Console can't verify a free Ryze subdomain. So connect your domain, add the blog as a property in Search Console, and verify. Switch to the S E O tab — hit check — verified. From there Ryze submits the sitemap itself and pings Google on every single publish. The full step-by-step doc is attached under this video. One last tip: add one link to the blog from your site's navigation — it starts ranking faster.

And when the articles start landing — here's where you watch them work. Open the Dashboard, Content tab: [pause] traffic per article, what's generated versus published, and which posts actually bring clicks.
So — a designed blog, hosted for you, indexed by Google, filling itself with articles. [smiling] Zero infrastructure. That's the Blog Studio.
